description: This file contains functions for establishing and managing a MongoDB connection using Mongoose, including connecting to the database, retrieving the database instance, and obtaining collections. It also sets up event listeners for connection events and logs relevant information.

methods.name: connectDB
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB using Mongoose, with configurable URI and options, and sets up event listeners for connection events.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Ensures an active database connection and returns the MongoDB database instance.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDB collection by name or list of candidate names, returning the first existing collection or defaulting to the first candidate.
